title: Researchers disclose two patched escapes from the OpenAI Codex sandbox
friendlyTitle: Update Codex after two sandbox escape fixes
summary: Accomplish researchers describe Overpatch, which abused Codex’s patch permissions to write outside the workspace, and Heapjack, which recovered a trust token from shared JavaScript heap memory to reach an unsandboxed parent process. OpenAI fixed both within eight days; the researchers recommend Codex CLI 0.149.0 and Desktop build 26.818.21641 or later.
friendlySummary: Researchers found two ways for code inside Codex’s safety box to reach files or commands outside it. OpenAI fixed both problems in newer CLI and Desktop versions.
whyItMatters: A coding agent may inspect hostile repositories, so its sandbox must withstand input designed to exploit the harness itself. Developers should update promptly and treat software-only sandboxing as one layer, keeping valuable credentials outside the agent environment and limiting host access.
friendlyWhyItMatters: A harmful repository can target the coding tool that opens it. Update Codex and keep important credentials away from the agent whenever possible.
